Why does every project start by building the same frontend again?

Bootstrap Package started in 2014 as the answer to that question.

It has been developed in the open ever since – by Benjamin Kott and dozens of contributors – and has shipped with every TYPO3 LTS since 6.2. Today it is one of the most installed TYPO3 extensions there is.

I already have a TYPO3 site. Can I add the package?

Yes. Require it, then add bootstrap-package/full – or the individual sets – to the dependencies of your site configuration. The demo content is only imported when TYPO3 sets up a fresh installation; an existing site keeps its pages.

Can I add the package?","hidden":"0","image_zoom":"0","imagecols":"2","media":"0","mediaorient":"left","starttime":"0","tt_content":"191"}
Ich habe schon eine TYPO3-Site. Kann ich das Paket ergänzen?

Ja. Installieren, dann bootstrap-package/full – oder die einzelnen Sets – zu den Abhängigkeiten deiner Site-Konfiguration hinzufügen. Der Demo-Content wird nur importiert, wenn TYPO3 eine frische Installation einrichtet; eine bestehende Site behält ihre Seiten.

{"bodytext":"

Through the Import\/Export module or the console: vendor\/bin\/typo3 impexp:import EXT:bootstrap_package\/Initialisation\/data.xml 0<\/code>. It adds a second page tree next to your own.<\/p>","endtime":"0","header":"How do I get the demo content into an existing site?","hidden":"0","image_zoom":"0","imagecols":"2","media":"0","mediaorient":"left","starttime":"0","tt_content":"191"}
Wie bekomme ich den Demo-Content in eine bestehende Site?
Über das Import/Export-Modul oder die Konsole: vendor/bin/typo3 impexp:import EXT:bootstrap_package/Initialisation/data.xml 0. Das legt einen zweiten Seitenbaum neben deinem an.

{"bodytext":"

Every template, partial and layout can be overridden through the template root paths in the settings. Start by copying the one file you want to change; the rest keeps coming from the package and stays updatable.<\/p>","endtime":"0","header":"Can I use my own templates?","hidden":"0","image_zoom":"0","imagecols":"2","media":"0","mediaorient":"left","starttime":"0","tt_content":"191"}

Jedes Template, Partial und Layout lässt sich über die Template-Root-Pfade in den Settings überschreiben. Kopiere zuerst nur die eine Datei, die du ändern willst; der Rest kommt weiter aus dem Paket und bleibt aktualisierbar.

{"bodytext":"

Update the package with Composer, run the upgrade wizards in the Install Tool. The package ships wizards that migrate its own content elements between versions, so your editors' work carries over.<\/p>","endtime":"0","header":"What happens on a TYPO3 major upgrade?","hidden":"0","image_zoom":"0","imagecols":"2","media":"0","mediaorient":"left","starttime":"0","tt_content":"191"}

Paket per Composer aktualisieren, Upgrade-Wizards im Install Tool ausführen. Das Paket bringt Wizards mit, die seine eigenen Inhaltselemente zwischen Versionen migrieren – die Arbeit deiner Redakteure bleibt erhalten.
How do I get the demo content into an existing site?
Through the Import/Export module or the console: vendor/bin/typo3 impexp:import EXT:bootstrap_package/Initialisation/data.xml 0. It adds a second page tree next to your own.
Can I use my own templates?

Every template, partial and layout can be overridden through the template root paths in the settings. Start by copying the one file you want to change; the rest keeps coming from the package and stays updatable.
What happens on a TYPO3 major upgrade?
Update the package with Composer, run the upgrade wizards in the Install Tool. The package ships wizards that migrate its own content elements between versions, so your editors' work carries over.

Can I add the package to an existing site?
Yes. Require it, then add bootstrap-package/full – or the individual sets – to the dependencies of your site configuration. The demo content is only imported when TYPO3 sets up a fresh installation.

Three sizes: standard, small, fullscreen · seven item types: header, text, call to action, image, text and image, background image, HTML · layouts: six theme colours or custom with free text and background colours · per item: header level and position, subheader, navigation title, button, link · per carousel: interval, slide or fade, wrap, autoplay, titles in the navigation · background images with fade, parallax and filter.

Kann ich das Paket zu einer bestehenden Site hinzufügen?

Ja. Installieren, dann bootstrap-package/full – oder die einzelnen Sets – zu den Abhängigkeiten deiner Site-Konfiguration hinzufügen. Der Demo-Content wird nur importiert, wenn TYPO3 eine frische Installation einrichtet.

{"bodytext":"

Three sizes: standard, small, fullscreen \u00b7 seven item types: header, text, call to action, image, text and image, background image, HTML \u00b7 layouts: six theme colours or custom with free text and background colours \u00b7 per item: header level and position, subheader, navigation title, button, link \u00b7 per carousel: interval, slide or fade, wrap, autoplay, titles in the navigation \u00b7 background images with fade, parallax and filter.<\/p>","endtime":"0","header":"Carousel","hidden":"0","image_zoom":"0","imagecols":"2","media":"0","mediaorient":"left","starttime":"0","tt_content":"105"}

Drei Größen: Standard, klein, Fullscreen · sieben Item-Typen: Überschrift, Text, Call to Action, Bild, Text und Bild, Hintergrundbild, HTML · Layouts: sechs Theme-Farben oder custom mit freier Text- und Hintergrundfarbe · je Item: Überschriftenebene und -position, Unterzeile, Navigationstitel, Button, Link · je Carousel: Intervall, Slide oder Fade, Endlosschleife, Autoplay, Titel in der Navigation · Hintergrundbilder mit Abdunklung, Parallax und Filter.

{"bodytext":"

Sections with text and media \u00b7 media left, right, above or below the text, in one to six columns, with lightbox \u00b7 one section or tab open by default \u00b7 section titles at the header level you choose.<\/p>","endtime":"0","header":"Accordion and tabs","hidden":"0","image_zoom":"0","imagecols":"2","media":"0","mediaorient":"left","starttime":"0","tt_content":"105"}

Can I use my own templates?
Every template, partial and layout can be overridden through the template root paths in the settings. Copy the one file you want to change; the rest keeps coming from the package.

What happens on a major upgrade?
Update the package with Composer, run the upgrade wizards. The package ships wizards that migrate its own content elements between versions.

Ratio 4:3, 16:9 or 1:1 · up to eight columns · pagination after a set number · images from the element or from a folder in the file list.

Der Großteil einer Website ist Text. Das sind die Elemente, die ihn tragen – und die Überschriften-Optionen, die alle gemeinsam haben.

Every element has a header with the same options: six layouts from H1 to H5 plus hidden, three positions, a subheader, a date, a link and a class that renders one level but looks like another. The editor offers the same scale inside the text:

Heading one, for the page

Heading two, for a section

Heading three, for a topic

Heading four, for a detail

Heading five, for a label

Überschrift zwei, für eine Sektion

Überschrift drei, für ein Thema

Überschrift vier, für ein Detail

The text element is the rich text editor. The preset that ships with the package offers what a page needs and hides what it does not.

Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, sub and superscript, inline code, abbreviations, links and button links. Lists, ordered and unordered, nested as deep as you need:

  • Unordered lists
  • with nested items
    • like this one
  1. Ordered lists
  2. count for you

Blockquotes render with a quiet left border in the tertiary colour.

Text can be centred –

– or aligned right.

Das Textelement ist der Rich-Text-Editor. Das mitgelieferte Preset bietet, was eine Seite braucht, und versteckt, was sie nicht braucht.

Fett, kursiv, unterstrichen, durchgestrichen, tief- und hochgestellt, Inline-Code, Abkürzungen, Links und Button-Links. Listen, geordnet und ungeordnet, so tief verschachtelt, wie du brauchst:

  • Ungeordnete Listen
  • mit verschachtelten Einträgen
    • wie diesem
  1. Geordnete Listen
  2. zählen für dich

Zitate rendern mit einer ruhigen linken Linie in der Tertiärfarbe.

Text kann zentriert sein –

– oder rechtsbündig.

Der Teaser ist ein kurzer, prominenter Absatz über dem Fließtext – für den einen Satz, den ein Leser nicht verpassen soll.
Darunter geht der Fließtext wie gewohnt weiter. Gut für Sektionseinstiege, Produktzusammenfassungen oder die Antwort vor der Erklärung.

Long text reads better in columns. The text column element flows one body text across two columns and collapses to one on phones. Column breaks follow the browser: paragraphs are balanced automatically, so an editor never has to split the text by hand.<\/p>\r\n

That keeps the element safe for content that changes often. Langer Text liest sich in Spalten besser. Das Spaltenelement verteilt einen Fließtext auf zwei Spalten und wird auf dem Handy einspaltig. Die Spaltenumbrüche setzt der Browser: Absätze werden automatisch ausbalanciert, ein Redakteur muss den Text nie von Hand teilen.

Das macht das Element sicher für Inhalte, die sich oft ändern. Kombiniert mit einer Linie oder Hintergrundfarbe liest sich die Sektion wie eine Magazin-Doppelseite – genau das macht diese hier, mit einer Linie darüber.

fieldlist.field:
The text element is the rich text editor. The preset that ships with the package offers what a page needs and hides what it does not.

Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, sub and superscript, inline code, abbreviations, links and button links. Lists, ordered and unordered, nested as deep as you need:

  • Unordered lists
  • with nested items
    • like this one
  1. Ordered lists
  2. count for you

Blockquotes render with a quiet left border in the tertiary colour.

Text can be centred –

– or aligned right.
The teaser is a short, prominent paragraph above the body text – for the one sentence a reader should not miss.
Below it the body text continues as usual. Use it for section intros, product summaries or the answer before the explanation.

Long text reads better in columns. The text column element flows one body text across two columns and collapses to one on phones. Column breaks follow the browser: paragraphs are balanced automatically, so an editor never has to split the text by hand.

That keeps the element safe for content that changes often. Combine it with a ruler or a background colour and the section reads like a magazine spread – which is what this one does, with a ruler above.
Text and icon: a text with an icon beside or above it, from two bundled icon sets or your own SVG.
Editors write in the elements they know. The rich text editor, the headline options and the appearance tab are the same on every element.
Teasers, columns, lists and panels structure a page without touching a template. Every one is a Bootstrap component underneath.
Publish in every language your site speaks. Three icon sources: Ionicons, a Glyphicon here, or an SVG of your own uploaded to the file list.
One line per item is all the bullet list, the list group and the table need – no HTML, no markup.
Create a TYPO3 project Require the package Run the setup Make it yours in the settings
Thirteen backend layouts Twenty-five content elements Fourteen menu types More than a hundred settings
The table element: striped, with a header row and a caption

Element|Best for|Options Text|Everything that is prose|Editor styles Text with teaser|Intros and summaries|Teaser paragraph Bullet list|Steps and short facts|Unordered, ordered, definitions List group|Feature lists|– Table|Data with a header|Striped, bordered, caption, footer row Panel|A highlighted box|Thirteen colours
The best interface is the one an editor never has to think about.
A box with a coloured header and a body – thirteen colours, three of them below with the jobs they are made for.
The info panel is for the note a reader should see but not stumble over. Calm, noticeable, out of the way.
Success for confirmations – the thank-you pages of the forms use it.
Warning for the things people skip: the recipient address of the contact form, the tracking id, the privacy page.

  • Umlaute und scharfes s: Äpfel, Öl, Übung, Straße
  • Akzente: café, niño, Zürich, Gdańsk, İstanbul

Für Layouts innerhalb einer Spalte – zwei oder drei Elemente nebeneinander, eine Card-Reihe – arbeitet Bootstrap Package mit b13/container zusammen. Installieren, das optionale Container-Set aktivieren, und die Grid-Container erscheinen im Wizard. Elemente darin erben jede Option von oben.
Space before and space after, each in five steps: extra-small, small, medium, large, extra-large.

Colour: primary, secondary, tertiary, quaternary, light or dark – the text colour follows.
Image: any image, with fade, parallax and a filter (grayscale, sepia, blur). Cropping variants apply as everywhere else.

For layouts inside a column – two or three elements side by side, a card row – Bootstrap Package integrates with b13/container. Install it, enable the optional container set, and the grid containers appear in the wizard. Elements inside inherit every option above.

Von null zur Website mit zwei Befehlen

Bootstrap Package ist eine Distribution: Wenn TYPO3 sich einrichtet, findet es den Demo-Content, den das Paket mitbringt, und importiert ihn – den Seitenbaum, die Bilder, beide Sprachen und die Site-Konfiguration. Was du gerade liest, ist so angekommen.

composer require bk2k/bootstrap-package
vendor/bin/typo3 setup

Nichts auf dieser Site wurde woanders konfiguriert. Ändere die Primärfarbe, speichere, lade neu – die ganze Site folgt. Sieh, was sonst noch ein Setting ist.

fieldlist.field:
composer require bk2k/bootstrap-package
vendor/bin/typo3 setup
Site sets instead of TypoScript templates
The frontend is delivered as TYPO3 site sets. Your site depends on bootstrap-package/full and gets everything – or you pick the sets you need and leave the rest out.

Bootstrap 5 – the framework, compiled from your settings Content Elements – every element on this site Backend Layouts – the thirteen page layouts RTE – a CKEditor preset that matches the theme Cookie Consent – the banner, configurable per setting Google Font – one setting, one font family Google Tag Manager – the container id, nothing else Pagination – shared pagination for galleries and lists Indexed Search – styled search form and results Skiplink – keyboard access to the content

Open the backend, go to Site Management and look at the Settings tab. Every option the package knows is listed there with its description and default value.

Nothing on this site was configured anywhere else. Change the primary colour, save, reload – the whole site follows. See what else is a setting.
